launch_notes: Operator launches run-loop.sh manually from /tmp/runner-0037-46.02, a dedicated git worktree of the main repository checked out on branch 0037-46.02. No launchd/systemd service; the process is not restarted by the OS. Continuous mode (no --once, no --cyclic): the runner waits for a request in the slot, executes it, moves it to the archive, then waits for the next one. This is the mode a sandboxed agent needs in order to work through a multi-step transaction without an operator restart between every request.
restart_notes: Manual restart — operator restarts as soon as crash is observed by re-running the invocation above.
rollback_notes: runner-host/run-loop.sh is tracked in the repository; restore it from HEAD in this worktree. Superseded note: the earlier rollback_path pointed into /tmp/autodocs, whose HEAD did not contain runner-host/ at all, so it could never have worked there.
